name: List.iterate.eq_def
script:
have h_main : (∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → α) (a : α) (x : ℕ), List.iterate f a x = match x with | 0 => [] | n.succ => a :: List.iterate f (f a) n) → False := by
  intro h
  have h₁ := h (α := PUnit) (f := id) (a := ()) (x := 0)
  simp [List.iterate] at h₁
  <;> contradiction

have h_final : ¬ (∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → α) (a : α) (x : ℕ), List.iterate f a x = match x with | 0 => [] | n.succ => a :: List.iterate f (f a) n) := by
  intro h_contra
  have h_false : False := h_main h_contra
  exact h_false

exact h_final
